Strategy: Bins that can still fit two more items of the current size after placement are preferred, emptier among them, while other bins use Best Fit with a penalty, so the rule protects bins with room for two repeats. It differs from Best Fit whenever such a roomy bin exists. It may help by banking capacity for repeated sizes, or fail by hoarding empty bins that never receive those repeats.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [((r - item) if r - item >= 2 * item else (-(r - item) - 50)) for r in bins]
```
